glossentry.glossdef: BACnet Broadcast Management Device is a device that receives and redistributes broadcast type BACnet messages (Who-Is, I-Am, etc.) to other B/IP devices on its own subnet and sends broadcasttype messages to BBMDs on other subnets. By having one BBMD on each subnet, a B/IP network can span subnets (between IP routers, which otherwise typically block broadcast type messages). A station supports operation as a BBMD.
